title: datacenter-btm-electricity-2026: code behind 'Megawatts to Zettaflops' (Electricity, 2026)
description: Code and data that regenerate every computed table and figure in Jones Jr. and Jones Sr. (2026), 'Megawatts to Zettaflops: A Techno-Economic Framework for Grid-Tied Behind-the-Meter Architectures in AI Data Centers', Electricity 7(2), 43, compare each number with the published article, and carry the authors' correction to Tables 12, 14 and 15. Code MIT; data, results and prose CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA and the README).
